newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Konzum raises unit's capital by HUF130 mln.
newsitem.headline: Konzum raises unit's capital by HUF130 mln.

text.p: Hungarian holding company Konzum Kereskedelmi es Ipari Rt KONU.BU said on Friday that it boosted its stake in its subsidiary, trading company Nyek-Ker Kft to 88.5 percent by raising its registered capital by 130 million forint.
Konzum also said in the Budapest Stock Exchange's official gazette that it sold a stake worth a nominal 30 million forint in its wholetrade subsidiary Konzum Nagykereskedelmi Kft.
Before the sale, Konzum's stake in the unit was worth 219.75 million forint at face value, Konzum said.
Konzum addded that it founded a joint venture in Bosnia.
The joint venture, Konzumgrad has a 10,000 mark registered capital, of which Konzum holds 49 percent, Konzum said.
